# Boss Stack

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** Boss Stack, BossStack

## What it does

Stacks boss bars to make your HUD less cluttered.

Description basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/MeteorDevelopment/meteor-client/blob/e3a2e77967629d216e127b5ceecf71fb15f9d2e5/src/main/java/meteordevelopment/meteorclient/systems/modules/render/BossStack.java). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
